conditions: Both operands are Number values and one is positive zero while the other is negative zero.
limitations: This is the distinction between the two named abstract operations for signed Number zero. JavaScript operators and library methods select their own comparison operations.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum or material counterexample affecting applicability.

statement: In ECMAScript 2024, SameValueZero treats Number positive zero and negative zero as equal in either argument order, while SameValue treats them as distinct.
